title: alf-finding-batch.v1
description: S055 §8 — schema-forced output of an alf Format-5 workflow-stage finder. Owner: alf. Home: _meta/schemas/. The finder writes ZERO files under .alf/ (the synthesis pipeline is the single consumer; the MAIN LOOP is the single .alf/ writer). Out-of-scope HIGH findings become handoff_requests[] DATA (no bob handoff, no tasks.md, no pa_*). Every finding carries feed_record or local evidence (HR5/HR6). Budget honesty via skipped[] + limits.

evidence.description: feed_record (the inventory-history line / rot finding / drift entry / identity row) OR local code evidence (HR6).

priority_score.description: Recomputed by synthesis from numeric inputs (not trusted from the finder).

handoff_requests.description: Out-of-scope HIGH findings as DATA — the finder never spawns bob or writes tasks.md.

skipped.description: Budget honesty (mirror of evo HR8): work not done and why.
